summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Champion Horse ecommerce. All 20 pytest backend tests pass (100%). Frontend flows (home → shop → produto → color/size → add-to-bag → SideCart inc/dec/subtotal → checkout → PayPal sandbox redirect) all work. Admin flow (/admlucas login → dashboard stat cards → tabs → new product creation via ProductForm → status change to 'pago' revealing MARCAR COMO ENVIADO button) all work.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warnings: missing DialogTitle & aria-describedby. Not user-visible but affects a11y. Wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle+Description.

action_items: Optional: add DialogTitle/VisuallyHidden inside SheetContent (SideCart) and DialogContent (ProductForm) to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/orders is public (no auth) — expected for guest checkout, but no rate-limit/CAPTCHA present; consider anti-abuse.

server.py: /api/webhook/paypal has no signature verification (PayPal webhook id/transmission headers). In production, must verify webhook signature to prevent forged 'paid' events. Currently any POST with an order_id can mark an order paid.

server.py: /api/files/{path} is fully public — anyone knowing a path can retrieve. Fine for product images, but 'is_deleted' filter only guards the record lookup content_type, get_object still fetches bytes even when record missing.
Checkout.jsx useEffect has [] dep but references items/navigate — lint warning likely; behavior fine on mount only.

server.py compute_totals: shipping cutoff uses subtotal >= 300 (matches spec 'grátis acima de 300' — technically 'acima' means > 300 but tests accept >=300; consistent with UI wording 'acima de R$300'). Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Seeded product 'Camiseta Champion Horse' auto-created on startup. Test created and deleted TEST_UI_Product; TEST_ orders remain in DB from pytest runs (guest orders have no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 20 tests). PayPal sandbox create-order works (real HTTP to api-m.sandbox.paypal.com). Webhook signature is NOT verified. Emergent object storage upload works end-to-end. Admin JWT stored in localStorage key ch_admin_token; cart in ch_cart. All data-testids match the request spec.
